what: In a title set one character per box (overflow hidden), each character rises 40px from below the box with a .1s stagger over .5s power4.out and settles. The box stays put and only the characters spring up from the box bottom. It fires once when the top edge reaches 95% of the screen. With on: load it runs immediately (the vertical large Hero title is 60px · .4s in the original).

options.y: Distance the text rises (px), default 40 — Hero big title 60
options.on: If load, runs right on attach without waiting to enter the viewport
options.--fx-cell: Cell size when the part builds its cells, default 1.25em
options.[data-fx-part=char]: Text inside the cell (cell clips overflow) — if absent, a cell is built for each letter

from.where: index.html .gu-card__title [data-sq] — original main.js .c-square-title__char__inner y 40 · stagger .1 · .5s power4.out · top 95%, and the hero’s .p-kv__inner__title__char__inner enters with y 60 · .4s · stagger .1, within the same entrance order

shared.css .cb-title span — chapter name in English caps (the whole title is one overflow-hidden cell). Original h2.title span translateY(80px)→0 .5s cubic-bezier(.045,.4,0,1.65), starting at 0.6s with .1s spacing, 200ms after the chapter is 10% visible
